The NTEE crosswalk is canonical, and its nteev2 columns are not

Source: R/md-sources.R
md_ntee_canonical.Rd

ntee_resolved_crosswalk supersedes the BMF's NTEE fields because it carries provenance: per-EIN it gives ntee_current, ntee_most_recent and ntee_modal, each with a subsector and an nteev2 rendering, plus ntee_most_recent_source, n_vintages_with_ntee, n_distinct_codes, an ntee_agreement verdict, and ntee_code_distribution - a JSON object giving each observed code's count and first/last vintage.

NTEE is not an invariant trait

Measured on a 400,000-row sample: ntee_agreement is unanimous for 62%, mixed for 31%, and single for 7%. Roughly a third of organisations have been classified inconsistently across vintages. Any schema that stores one NTEE code per EIN without saying which rule produced it, and without surfacing that the underlying history disagreed, is presenting a coin flip as a fact.

Note also that ntee_current is populated for only 34.7% of rows while ntee_most_recent is populated for 100%. current means "currently listed", not "the current value" - most EINs in the unified file are not in the active BMF at all.

The nteev2 columns carry the known defect

They are populated, and they must still be recomputed with fiscal::get_nteev2() rather than taken as given. The specialty double-encoding documented in pfmatch/dev/SCHEDI-ALIAS-FINDINGS.md §6d is present: B11 renders as EDU-B11-MS where the correct value is EDU-B00-MS. In NTEEv2 the digits 01-19 encode organisation type, not activity, so the activity slot is B00 and the type is carried by the MS suffix - this file emits 11 in both slots.

21,983 of the 400,000 sampled rows (5.5%) carry a 10-19 org-type code and are affected. Others seen: D11 -> ENV-D11-MS, S11 -> PSB-S11-MS, N12 -> HMS-N12-MM, X19 -> REL-X19-NS.

Recompute from ntee_code_raw, not from a cleaned three-character code: the legacy five-character form carries the B8443 -> B43 rule, which truncation destroys.
